decision_rule:
R12 IS THE BASE TEXT OF THIS ONE SELF-CONTAINED SPECIFICATION, EVERY CLAUSE OF WHICH IS ACTIVE, AND IT CARRIES ONE EXPLICIT PRECEDENCE ORDER: WHERE TWO CLAUSES CONFLICT, THE LATER-NUMBERED REPAIR GOVERNS - R34 > R33 > R32 > R31 > R30 > R29 > R28 > R27 > R26 > R25 > R24 > R23 > R22 > R21 > R20 > R18 > R17 > R16 > R15 > R12 (R19 ranks between R20 and R18) - and every clause is read AS AMENDED BY EVERY LATER CLAUSE THAT NAMES IT. THERE IS NO AMENDMENT STACK ACROSS FILES: nothing outside this card governs, and the superseded R4-R11 chain is archived for provenance only in DESIGN_REVISION_HISTORY.md and has NO force. Wherever any other artifact differs from the sections below, those sections govern. Section N lists every inference that is VOID.

R15. Sections A-N stand as written except where R15-F1 to R15-F4 amend them; where they differ, R15 governs.

R15-F1 THE CONFIRMATORY ENDPOINT IS A BALANCED, MARGIN-FREE INTERACTION CONTRAST AND THE PAIR QUANTITIES ARE SIMPLE EFFECTS. Operative content: with E*(p,d) = a_p + b_d + g_pd, Delta_mis_bar = (1/L)*sum_{p in A} E*(p,p) - (1/(L(L-1)))*sum_{p != d in A} E*(p,d) over the admitted set A, whose weights sum to zero along every row and column, so it is a PURE INTERACTION CONTRAST; the six ordered Delta_mis(p,d) are SECONDARY DESCRIPTIVE simple effects that gate nothing beyond condition B(3) (R22-F4).

R15-F2, R15-F3, R15-F4, R16-F2, R16-F3, R16-F5, R16-F6 AND R16-F7 ARE BINDING AS WRITTEN HERE UNDER THEIR OWN LABELS (R21-F2), AS AMENDED BY R17. In one line each: the claim is POLE SEPARATION and the neutral arm carries ZERO weight, no persona-versus-neutral magnitude being an endpoint (R15-F2); the pre-B1 qualification gate is its own enumerated family on the qualification partition with its own error budget and a deterministic, discretion-free consequence (R15-F3); the apparatus-artifact exclusion is EXPLORATORY and gates and falsifies nothing (R15-F4); admission rejects in the UPPER TAIL ONLY, iff the simultaneous LOWER bound exceeds f_diag = 0.18, the |t| reading being VOID (R16-F2); L = 3 is mandatory in every admitted checkpoint and the L = 2 branch is VOID (R16-F3); the target-language competence screen runs on its own hashed 50-prompt QUALIFICATION sample, never on tuning material (R16-F5); the pre-B0 power certificate of record - AS AMENDED BY R30-F1, POWER_SIM_R30_FINAL.json - must exist before any B0 GPU hour and every power, delta_alt and seed-count assertion is read from it (R16-F6); and every artifact carries the label set of record and no other, consistency_check.py exiting BLOCK on the readings enumerated there, its PASS being a precondition of B0 (R16-F7).

A. ESTIMAND AND THE ONE CONFIRMATORY ALGORITHM.
The confirmatory estimand is Delta_mis_bar AS REDEFINED BY R15-F1 - the BALANCED MATCH-MINUS-MISMATCH INTERACTION CONTRAST over the admitted L x L language subtable, per admitted checkpoint and per targeted trait, the admitted languages fixed BEFORE B1 by the enumerated qualification-gate family of R15-F3. It is computed by this algorithm, in this order and no other. (1) UNIT SCORE: for every generation unit u = (cell, setting, scenario, seed) compute the behavior-channel trait score of outcome.primary_metric, carrying u's frozen engine label e(u) and wording label w(u) from NUISANCE_SCHEDULE.json; no aggregation precedes this step. (2) MATCHED UNIT DIFFERENCE: form the persona-minus-neutral difference at UNIT level, the neutral arm matched on (scenario, seed, engine) - the schedule assigns the same engine to both arms - one difference per (cell, setting, scenario, seed), engine label intact. (3) WITHIN-STRATUM AGGREGATION: within each of the three FIXED engine strata e, average the matched differences over the (scenario, seed) units assigned to e, giving E_q^(e); wording is balanced inside the stratum. (4) POLE ALIGNMENT AND CONTRAST WITHIN STRATUM: form E*^(e)(p,d) = 0.5[E_high^(e) - E_low^(e)] and then Delta_mis^(e)(p,d) = E*^(e)(p,p) - E*^(e)(p,d), both inside the same stratum. (5) ENGINE COMBINATION: Delta_mis(p,d) = (1/3) sum over the three strata of Delta_mis^(e)(p,d); this and only this is eq1's equal-weight combination. (6) PAIR AVERAGE: average the pre-B1 eligible pairs to Delta_mis_bar. (7) INFERENCE: section I as amended by R26, and nothing else. (8) CLIPPING: R28-F2 fixes the ONE clipping location; the 'every confirmatory quantity' and 'clipped to [-1.5, 1.5]' readings are VOID.
The three forward-translation engines are a FROZEN, EXHAUSTIVE, FIXED SET, never resampled; resampling happens WITHIN a stratum. ENGINE INVARIANCE IS A REPORTED CHECK, NOT AN INFERENCE: the three within-stratum estimates of Delta_mis_bar must be SIGN-CONCORDANT, else the checkpoint does not count toward B(1) (R24-F4; the narrowed-wording reading is VOID).

B. THE COMPLETE H1 RULE. H1 is supported only if ALL FIVE conditions hold, INDEPENDENTLY FOR EACH OF THE TWO PRE-REGISTERED TARGETED TRAITS - there is no cross-trait pooling, no equal-weight cross-trait estimand and no 1-of-2 allowance; if the rule holds for exactly one trait, H1 is NOT supported and the study reports a TRAIT-SPECIFIC result naming the trait it holds for and the one it fails for, in the title, abstract and contribution list.
(1) Delta_mis_bar is POSITIVE with its R26-F4 lower bound above zero (section I(iv) AS AMENDED BY R26-F4) in AT LEAST 3 OF THE 4 CHECKPOINTS ADMITTED BEFORE B1 under section F.
(2) BOUNDARY, AS AMENDED BY R26-F3, R26-F4 AND R27-F3: on the CLIPPED scale and the R26-F1 budget, L(Delta_mis_bar) > beta_0 = max(delta_raw = 0.09, 2*v0), the REGISTERED CONSTANT of R27-F3. That ONE bound IS the test; the point comparison Delta_mis_bar >= beta_0 is descriptive only. The 2*U(V_hat) limb and the joint bootstrap propagation are VOID as inference and survive as agreement checks.
(3) CONSISTENCY: in each checkpoint that counts toward (1), at least 4 of the 6 ordered pair-specific mismatch SIMPLE EFFECTS (R15-F1) - counted inside the admitted subtable only - are positive in point estimate, so the result cannot be carried by a single language pair.
(4) POLE CONCORDANCE, A DESCRIPTIVE SIDE-CONDITION (R15-F2) carrying no threshold and no claim: in E*(p,d) = 0.5*[E_high - E_low] the shared neutral arm B cancels and the endpoint IS the HIGH-VERSUS-LOW POLE SEPARATION that H1 claims. AS AMENDED BY R24-F4: for every admitted checkpoint, every targeted trait AND EVERY ORDERED PAIR (p,d) OF THE ADMITTED SUBTABLE WITH p != d, BOTH POLE-SPECIFIC MISMATCH CONTRASTS AS DEFINED BY R25-F3 - C_high(p,d) = E_high(p,p) - E_high(p,d) and C_low(p,d) = -[E_low(p,p) - E_low(p,d)] on the rule-A(3) cell effects, WHICH ALREADY CARRY THE MATCHED PERSONA-MINUS-NEUTRAL DIFFERENCE OF RULE A(2), engine-combined as in rule A(5) - must be POSITIVE IN POINT ESTIMATE; every further subtraction of B is VOID and the bracketed [E_high - B] wording is VOID. NO AGGREGATE, AVERAGE OR MAJORITY READING EXISTS. FAILURE IN A CHECKPOINT MEANS CONDITION (4) FAILS THERE, so it does not count toward B(1); the earlier sentence letting a disagreement merely narrow the claim is VOID.
(5) The behavior channel is ADMITTED under section F3 and at least 3 of the 4 checkpoints remain admitted.
Conditions (3) and (4) are ROBUSTNESS SIDE-CONDITIONS that can only make declaration harder; they set no threshold, carry no claim and are never described as what the study tests. Conditions (1) and (2) ARE the test of the boundary.

C. THE CLAIM, AND THE FALSIFIER OF RECORD. The confirmatory claim of H1 is that Delta_mis_bar, ON THE R26-F3 CLIPPED SCALE, EXCEEDS THE REGISTERED CONSTANT BOUNDARY beta_0 = max(delta_raw = 0.09, 2*v0), CAPPED AT 0.10 AND FROZEN BEFORE B0 (R27-F3; the 2*V_hat reading is VOID), AND NOTHING LARGER. delta_alt = 0.38 is a POWER STATEMENT ONLY - the effect size at which the complete conjunction attains 0.80 power (section J). It is never a threshold, never a claim boundary and never appears in a decision.
The one exhaustive rule lives in pico.hypothesis.falsifier every artifact AND IS NOT RESTATED HERE; this field states NO independent falsifier, and neither does any other field, section or document. It is applied per targeted trait over the admitted checkpoints with the SAME primary family, the SAME section-I(iv) region and the R27-F5 quantifier, its outcome (B) limbs are sign-symmetric, and outcome (C) keeps every remaining case including the 0.09-0.38 uninformative band, every UNTESTABLE branch of sections F and J and every failure of the behavior channel to be admitted.
consistency_check.py scans design_card.json, METHOD_DESIGN.md and EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md for any competing refutation path - any 'falsif'/'refut'/'rejects H1' string outside pico.hypothesis.falsifier that is not an explicit pointer to it - and EXITS NONZERO if one is found; it must pass before the pre-registration is frozen and again before analysis; a blanket 'earlier language is void' sentence is not sufficient.

D. THRESHOLDS, ALL FIXED HERE AND DERIVED FROM NOTHING (R21-F1). delta_raw = 0.09 native scale points UNIVERSALLY, for every model, trait, pair, cell and family; it is the SESOI and, through beta_0 (R27-F3), the tested boundary. No tuning quantity enters it and the rule reading delta_raw = 0.15 x median|Delta(s,s)| IS DELETED. f_diag = 0.18 is the practical diagonal-inducibility floor, an ADMISSION margin and not a claim boundary. epsilon_raw = 0.045 is the descriptive TOST margin of H3.
V_{m,k} is the REPEATED-CONDITION SD of the pole-aligned cell effect: across the registered seeds of the scenario-averaged E*(p,p) in the three DIAGONAL cells, pooled over cells and over the two targeted traits' persona settings. AS AMENDED BY R27-F3, v0 IS THIS QUANTITY ESTIMATED ON THE QUALIFICATION SEED BLOCK ALONE AND FROZEN IN BOUNDARY_CONST.json BEFORE B0. Estimator, frozen with the pre-registration: V_hat = sqrt( (1/(C*(S-1))) * sum over the C pooled cell-settings and the S registered seeds of (E*_hat_{c,s} - E*_bar_c)^2 ). V_hat is a REPORTED DESCRIPTIVE dispersion on the clipped scale and enters NO inference; the chi-square interval is VOID and the tested boundary is the registered constant beta_0 (R27-F3), never raised to buy power.

E. THE CORPUS IS PARTITIONED ONCE, BEFORE ANY DEVELOPMENT CHOICE IS MADE. The registered corpus is exactly 180 support scenarios, partitioned ONCE - before any prompt is written and before any pipeline runs - into TUNING = 30, QUALIFICATION = 60 and EVALUATION = 90, mutually disjoint, frozen and hashed as SCENARIO_PARTITION.json together with the FULL RUN TENSOR (the outcome.n_runs enumeration) hashed as RUN_TENSOR.json; every card field naming a corpus size names these 180 = 30 + 60 + 90 scenarios and no other count exists.
ALL development-time selection - prompt and persona wording, parsing rules, scorer and rubric configuration, translation-pipeline settings, the dispersion re-estimate, f_diag, the anchor coefficients and the section-J variance components (delta_raw is fixed by R21-F1, derived from nothing) - runs on the TUNING partition ONLY. QUALIFICATION is UNTOUCHED until read once, before B1, for exactly the gates of sections F1 and F2, on the R26-F6 seed block. EVALUATION is untouched until B1 opens. No development-time selection ever sees a qualification or evaluation scenario.
Scenarios are a FROZEN PURPOSIVE CORPUS and are NEVER RESAMPLED in confirmatory inference: every confirmatory interval is CONDITIONAL ON THE 90 FIXED EVALUATION SCENARIOS, the only confirmatory resampling unit is the R27-F2 subsample cluster (section I at n_U = 144), and the corpus is never enlarged, re-cut or re-used across partitions.

F. THE PRE-B1 GATES. Every gate below runs ONLY on the qualification partition or on development material, is decided BEFORE B1 OPENS, and its outcome - the ADMITTED CHECKPOINT SET, the ELIGIBLE PAIR SET, the primary family and the estimand composition - is FROZEN AND HASHED into ELIGIBLE_PAIRS.json at that moment and CANNOT CHANGE once any confirmatory transcript exists. Diagonal and validity quantities estimated on the confirmatory split are reported descriptively only.
F1. PAIR ELIGIBILITY IS SUPERSEDED AND ARCHIVED. Its pair-level eligibility rule is VOID: R15-F3 replaces it with the enumerated gate family and the LANGUAGE-LEVEL admission map, R16-F2 gives limb (ii) - ENUMERATED IN R22-F1 - its one-sided form and R16-F3 makes L = 3 mandatory, and those clauses GOVERN. What survives from F1: the section-H2 qualification tensor, ENUMERATED IN FULL IN R22-F1 SAMPLE and budgeted in outcome.n_runs, of which the 720 F2 transcripts are the registered stratified annotation subsample; the DEFAULT ESTIMAND IS THE FIXED ALL-SIX-PAIR AVERAGE, no pair is ever dropped after B1, and the pre-B1 gate tests are members of NO confirmatory family. 'Eligible pair' means everywhere an ordered pair inside the admitted 3 x 3 subtable.
F2. EVALUATOR VALIDITY IS ESTIMATED AT THE SCENARIO-CLUSTER LEVEL INSIDE EACH CHECKPOINT-LANGUAGE CELL - 720 blind double-annotated adjudicated transcripts, 60 independent scenario clusters per cell, every threshold estimated inside its own cell on the FROZEN R24-F3 SAMPLE MAP by the qualification-cluster bootstrap-t of rule I(iii) (THE BCa SCENARIO BOOTSTRAP OF F2 IS VOID; R24-F3 GOVERNS), the cell rater-versus-criterion correlation needing a 95% lower bound above 0.40 and the pooled bound above 0.60.
F3. ADMISSION, DETERMINISTIC, AS AMENDED BY R16-F1, R16-F4 AND R16-F5. THE ADMISSION MAP OF R22-F1 GOVERNS AND IS NOT RESTATED HERE: limbs (i)-(iv) and every section-F2 threshold must pass in each of a checkpoint's three cells, a checkpoint keeps all three languages or is not admitted (R16-F3), and if fewer than 3 of the 4 remain the behavior channel is NOT ADMITTED and H1 takes outcome (C). The anchor slope, intercept and cross-language slope-equivalence margin are DESCRIPTIVE and gate nothing, because R16-F4(a) forms every confirmatory contrast on the RAW NATIVE 1-7 rubric mean. No margin, rubric item, anchor, cue list or threshold may change after any transcript is scored. The 20% rater-language subsample (H2b) is NON-GATING: a failure there is disclosed wherever the headline is stated and narrows the claim, but never removes a checkpoint, changes the family or changes an admission.
F4. GATE POWER IS DEMONSTRATED, NOT ASSUMED, AT THE INFORMATION THE GATE HAS. AS REWRITTEN BY R30-F2: refine-logs/gate_power_check_r30.py, run on the R16-F6 conservative variance inputs, must show at least 0.90 power for the CONJUNCTION OF ALL 24 LIMB-(i) LIMBS at the anticipated diagonal effect of 0.60, by the EXACT gate procedure on the 24 QUALIFICATION SEED CLUSTERS of R26-F6, and filed as power/GATE_POWER_R30_FINAL.json before B1; power_sim_r9.py, POWER_SIM_R9.json and the 'AT n_U = 144' reading are VOID. IF IT IS BELOW 0.90 AT THE REGISTERED Q = 60: H1 is UNTESTABLE on the behavior channel and takes outcome (C); THE CORPUS IS NOT ENLARGED, no threshold is relaxed and no scenario is reused. BINDING AS WRITTEN (R21-F2); its figures are certified under R16-F6 and R17-F2 and nowhere else.

G. THE BEHAVIOR RUBRIC AND SCALE, frozen and hashed as RUBRIC_BEHAVIOR.md before any generation, AS AMENDED BY R16-F1 AND R16-F4(a). For each targeted trait the rater scores the transcript on SIX facet items derived from that trait's BFI-2 facet definitions in customer-support terms - Extraversion: sociability, assertiveness, energy level; Agreeableness: compassion, respectfulness, trust; two items per facet - each on an INTEGER 1-7 scale with written anchors at 1, 4 and 7. THE CLAUSE RENDERING THE RUBRIC AND ANCHORS INTO THE TRANSCRIPT LANGUAGE IS VOID: the instrument is ENGLISH in every cell (R16-F1(a)), so the measuring instrument never varies with the dialogue language. The trait score is the EQUAL-WEIGHT MEAN of its six items on the RAW NATIVE 1-7 scale, with no anchor calibration anywhere in the confirmatory endpoint (R16-F4(a)). The item list IS the cue-to-trait mapping: no weight, item or cue is estimated from data, nothing outside the six items enters the score, and the rater returns all six. The rater-free indicators of controls.evaluator_validity are a descriptive convergence check.

H. THE RUN TENSOR AND THE COMPLETE SEED SCHEDULE, BOTH REGISTERED BEFORE M1. Translation engine and persona wording are NOT crossed with seed and add NO runs. Within each (checkpoint, cell, setting) the 90 scenarios x S seeds generation units are partitioned by the single frozen schedule into the 9 (engine, wording) blocks in equal counts, so engine is orthogonal to wording, seed and scenario stratum, and within every scenario the seeds receive engines in the registered near-equal counts, the deficient engine rotated across scenarios (wording independently, same rule). THE ENGINE LABEL IS A PROPERTY OF THE GENERATION UNIT and is carried through every step of section A.
THE SEED SCHEDULE IS COMPLETE, FIXED AND RUNNABLE. AS AMENDED BY R17-F2 AND R26-F5: THE CONFIRMATORY SEED COUNT IS S = 24, FIXED, with no allowed-count list, M2 selection step, adaptive branch or escalation; the earlier S in {8,...,12} list and its power-triggered selection are VOID. The generation seed list is 20260911 + {0..23}; THE QUALIFICATION-AND-GATE SEED BLOCK IS THE DISJOINT 20260811 + {0..23} (R26-F6). AS AMENDED BY R27-F2, the EVALUATION GENERATION IS RE-INDEXED INTO n_U = 144 SUBSAMPLE UNITS UNDER SUB-STREAMS 20260911 + 1000*u AT AN UNCHANGED TOTAL, and S = 24 survives ONLY as the generation-tensor label. The run tensor and the nuisance allocation are generated by schedule/make_run_tensor.py BEFORE M1 and hashed into RUN_TENSOR.json and NUISANCE_SCHEDULE.json, satisfying the orthogonality rule at S = 24: 9 x 5 x 4 x 90 x 24 = 388 800 confirmatory transcripts. The DESCRIPTIVE omnibus grid (C) is a SEPARATE, NEVER-CONFIRMATORY block at 27 cells x 5 settings x 4 checkpoints x a 30-scenario subset x 4 seeds = 64 800 transcripts, no confirmatory count ever being read from it. H2. THE QUALIFICATION RUN TENSOR IS SEPARATE, EXECUTABLE AND SCHEDULED BY THE SAME RULE. Its allocation comes from the same schedule/make_nuisance_schedule.py run, hashed into NUISANCE_SCHEDULE.json as its own indexed block: within each (checkpoint-language cell, setting) the 60 x 24 units are split into the 9 (engine, wording) blocks in equal counts, engine orthogonal to wording, seed and scenario, the deficient engine rotated across scenarios. Counts at S = 24: 12 x 60 x 5 x 24 = 86 400 transcripts on the R26-F6 qualification seed block. SCORING: each is scored once by the frozen 24B rater at instrument language I = D under section G's rubric; no human annotation is required outside F2's 720-transcript subsample and no self-report runs here. It is generated and scored in B0, before B1, and its transcripts never enter a confirmatory estimate.


I. THE INTERVAL AND THE MULTIPLICITY ALGORITHM ARE UNIQUELY EXECUTABLE. (i) THE RESAMPLING UNIT IS THE R27-F2 INFERENTIAL UNIT, AND ONLY IT. There are n_U = 144 I.I.D. subsample clusters (R27-F1 AND R27-F2; the G = S = 24 seed-cluster reading is VOID AS THE INFERENTIAL n); unit u holds EVERY unit-level matched difference of its own 15-scenario subsample, across all cells, settings, strata, checkpoints and traits. The 90 evaluation scenarios are FIXED and the only evaluation randomness is the registered subsample draw and the unit's seed sub-stream (rule E): no scenario, (scenario, seed) pair or transcript is a confirmatory resampling unit (section N). (ii) RESIDUALS AND WEIGHTS: a unit-level difference's residual is that difference minus the fitted value of its (engine stratum x cell x setting) mean under the imposed null; one WEBB 6-POINT weight is drawn PER INFERENTIAL UNIT PER REPLICATION and SHARED GLOBALLY, multiplying every residual of that unit at once, preserving dependence across contrasts sharing units; 9999 replications, generator seed 20260911, null imposed, the three engine strata recombined at weight 1/3. (iii) STUDENTIZATION AND V_hat: every statistic is divided by the cluster-robust standard error over those same n_U units with the finite-cluster correction n_U/(n_U - 1); NO t or normal approximation is used anywhere. V_hat is the repeated-condition SD across units on n_U - 1 df; AS AMENDED BY R26-F2 AND R27-F3, it is DESCRIPTIVE and enters NO inference. (iv) THE PRIMARY FAMILY IS ENUMERATED AND FROZEN BEFORE B1 IN ELIGIBLE_PAIRS.json AND HOLDS EXACTLY ONE COMPONENT PER (ADMITTED CHECKPOINT x TARGETED TRAIT) MEMBER - Delta_mis_bar - at most 4 x 2 = 8 components read through the K = 16 primitive bounds of R27-F4; the Delta_mis_bar - 2*V component is VOID with the limb that read it. R13's STEP-DOWN CONSTRUCTION and R14's STUDENTIZED SINGLE-STEP MAX-T TEST ARE VOID AS INFERENCE, surviving ONLY as a REPORTED AGREEMENT CHECK that DECLARES AND GATES NOTHING (R26-F4); the single R17 level 0.965 and the primary-family q* = 0.998 are VOID AS ERROR BUDGETS (R26-F1). THE REGION OF RECORD, WHICH EVERY DECISION AND THE FALSIFIER READ AND NOTHING OVERRIDES, IS THE R26-F4 SIMULTANEOUS BETTING REGION AT alpha_j = 0.003125 ON THE R26-F1 ERROR BUDGET, formed on the R26-F3 CLIPPED unit contributions. A null value is REJECTED IFF IT LIES OUTSIDE THAT COMPONENT'S R26-F4 BOUND, so rejection and non-coverage are THE SAME EVENT. B(1) is L(Delta_mis_bar) > 0; B(2) is L(Delta_mis_bar) > beta_0 (R27-F3); C(B1) equivalence is the two-sided R26-F4 region lying wholly inside +-delta_raw; C(B2) reversal is its upper bound < -delta_raw. At most one can hold, and B(2) implies B(1) because beta_0 > 0. The VOID list of section N item (7) governs both confirmatory families. (v) THE PAIR-LEVEL FAMILY IS SEPARATE AND GATED: the 6 ordered pair-specific Delta_mis(p,d) of each admitted checkpoint and trait form their OWN fixed family, reported after the primary family, on its OWN R26-F1 budget with its own R26-F4 bounds. Condition (3) reads point estimates there and can only make declaration harder. Conditions (1) and (2) and outcomes (B1) and (B2) read the PRIMARY family's region and no other interval.

R26-F4 THE BOUND IS WRITTEN OUT HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE. THE PROCEDURE IN FULL. Let X_1 ... X_n be the independent bounded variables of the limb in registered unit order, [a, b] their registered range, U_t = (X_t - a)/(b - a) in [0, 1], alpha = alpha_j of R26-F1. PREDICTABLE PLUG-INS, on the first t observations alone: mu_t = (0.5 + sum_{i<=t} U_i) / (1 + t) and sigma_t^2 = (0.25 + sum_{i<=t} (U_i - mu_i)^2) / (1 + t). BETTING SEQUENCE at a candidate mean m in (0, 1): lambda_t(m) = min( 0.5 / m, sqrt( 2 * ln(1/alpha) / ( sigma_{t-1}^2 * n * ln(1 + n) ) ) ), lambda_t >= 0, with sigma_0^2 = 0.25. CAPITAL PROCESS: K_n(m) = product over t = 1..n of ( 1 + lambda_t(m) * (U_t - m) ). The one-sided LOWER bound is L_U = inf { m in [0, 1] : K_n(m) < 1/alpha }, by bisection to 1e-9, and L = a + (b - a) * L_U. The UPPER bound is the SAME construction on 1 - U_t, giving L_U', mapped back as U_bound = a + (b - a) * (1 - L_U'). Empty sets, ties and numerical failure resolve CONSERVATIVELY to L = a, U_bound = b. This is the ONLY interval construction the declaration and the falsifier read; rule I(iv)'s max-T bootstrap region and every max-T pointer in rules B and C and in pico.hypothesis.falsifier are DEMOTED to agreement checks that declare and gate nothing (R25-F1(d); R22-F4 unaffected).

[R29-F2] THE ALTERNATIVE VECTOR IS ENUMERATED AND THE CERTIFICATE IS REPRODUCIBLE.
